requirements.name: years of experience
requirements.source: - 3+ years of experience in cloud security, infrastructure or platform engineering.

requirements.name: AWS IAM
requirements.source: - Hands-on experience securing AWS, including IAM policy design.

requirements.name: Kubernetes in production
requirements.source: - Experience operating Kubernetes in production and securing workloads on it.

requirements.name: infrastructure as code
requirements.source: - Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform.

requirements.name: programming in Go or Python
requirements.source: - Programming experience in Go or Python.

requirements.name: network security fundamentals
requirements.source: - An understanding of network security fundamentals in the cloud (VPCs, security groups, private connectivity).

requirements.name: bachelor's degree
requirements.source: - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

requirements.name: AWS IAM account structure
requirements.source: - Design and maintain IAM for our AWS organization: account structure, permission boundaries, service control policies and least-privilege roles for people and workloads.

requirements.name: workload identity
requirements.source: - Move services from long-lived credentials to workload identity (IAM Roles for Service Accounts and short-lived tokens).

requirements.name: EKS hardening
requirements.source: - Harden our EKS clusters: pod security standards, network policies, admission control and runtime monitoring.

requirements.name: policy-as-code in CI
requirements.source: - Review Terraform changes for security issues and build policy-as-code checks into CI.

requirements.name: detections and incident response
requirements.source: - Build detections on CloudTrail, VPC flow logs and Kubernetes audit logs, and take part in the incident response rotation.

requirements.name: security architecture reviews
requirements.source: - Run security architecture reviews for new services and data flows, and document the trust boundaries.

requirements.name: security tooling development
requirements.source: - Write internal tools in Go or Python that automate our security checks.

requirements.name: AWS security certification
requirements.source: - AWS Certified Security - Specialty or similar certification.

requirements.name: policy engines
requirements.source: - Experience with Open Policy Agent, Kyverno or similar policy engines.

requirements.name: secrets and key management
requirements.source: - Experience with secrets management and key management (AWS KMS).

requirements.name: application security or detection engineering
requirements.source: - Background in application security or detection engineering.
